items.question: Trong câu "SQL will happily average typos, count one payment twice and file a late-night purchase under the wrong day.", từ "typo" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "SQL will happily average typos, count one payment twice and file a late-night purchase under the wrong day.", what does "typo" (noun) mean?
options: lỗi gõ phím, lỗi đánh máy
optionsEn: a style of lettering, a font
a kind of data in a table
items.explanation: typo /ˈtaɪ.pəʊ/ (danh từ): lỗi gõ phím, lỗi đánh máy. "A typo in the income field" = lỗi gõ ở ô thu nhập.
items.explanationEn: typo /ˈtaɪ.pəʊ/ (noun): a mistake made when typing. "A typo in the income field" is a typing mistake in that field.

items.question: Trong câu "SQL will happily average typos, count one payment twice and file a late-night purchase under the wrong day.", từ "file" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "SQL will happily average typos, count one payment twice and file a late-night purchase under the wrong day.", what does "file" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to put into a category or group
to submit officially, e.g. an application
to smooth with a metal tool
items.explanation: file /faɪl/ (động từ): xếp (vào một mục, một nhóm). "File X under Y" = xếp X vào mục Y. Nghĩa khác: "file a complaint" = nộp đơn khiếu nại.
items.explanationEn: file /faɪl/ (verb): to put into a category or group. "File X under Y" means put X in category Y. Another sense: "file a complaint" (submit it).

items.question: Trong câu "SQL will happily average typos, count one payment twice and file a late-night purchase under the wrong day.", từ "happily" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "SQL will happily average typos, count one payment twice and file a late-night purchase under the wrong day.", what does "happily" (adverb) mean?
options: một cách vui vẻ, hạnh phúc
sẵn sàng, không hề phản đối
items.explanation: happily /ˈhæp.əl.i/ (trạng từ): sẵn sàng, không hề phản đối. Ở đây "happily" nghĩa là SQL cứ thế làm mà không cảnh báo gì.
items.explanationEn: happily /ˈhæp.əl.i/ (adverb): readily, without any objection. Here "happily" means SQL does it without any warning or complaint.

items.question: Trong câu "So 232 of 4,000 customers (about 5.8%) never declared an income.", từ "declare" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "So 232 of 4,000 customers (about 5.8%) never declared an income.", what does "declare" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to state officially, e.g. on a form
items.explanation: declare /dɪˈkleə(r)/ (động từ): khai báo. "Self-declared income" = thu nhập tự khai, chưa được kiểm chứng.
items.explanationEn: declare /dɪˈkleə(r)/ (verb): to state officially, e.g. on a form. "Self-declared income" is stated by the customer and not verified.

items.question: Trong câu "`AVG` silently skips NULLs, so an average describes only the people who answered.", từ "silently" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "`AVG` silently skips NULLs, so an average describes only the people who answered.", what does "silently" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: silently /ˈsaɪ.lənt.li/ (trạng từ): lặng lẽ, không báo gì. "Silently drop / skip" = bỏ qua mà không thông báo, kiểu lỗi khó phát hiện.
items.explanationEn: silently /ˈsaɪ.lənt.li/ (adverb): without any warning or message. "Silently drop / skip": discard without telling you, which makes errors hard to spot.

items.question: Trong câu "The gap is your missing data.", từ "gap" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The gap is your missing data.", what does "gap" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: gap /ɡæp/ (danh từ): khoảng chênh lệch, phần thiếu. "The gap between X and Y" = khoảng chênh giữa X và Y.
items.explanationEn: gap /ɡæp/ (noun): a difference or missing part. "The gap between X and Y" is the difference between them.

items.question: Trong câu "Missing incomes appear in all four employment types; salaried has the most (133) simply because it is the biggest group.", từ "salaried" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Missing incomes appear in all four employment types; salaried has the most (133) simply because it is the biggest group.", what does "salaried" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: paid a regular salary by an employer
items.explanation: salaried /ˈsæl.ər.id/ (tính từ): làm công ăn lương. "Salaried employee" = người làm công ăn lương, đối lập với "self-employed".
items.explanationEn: salaried /ˈsæl.ər.id/ (adjective): paid a regular salary by an employer. A "salaried employee" is the opposite of "self-employed".

items.question: Trong câu "Options for missing values, safest first: report the share missing; segment them as their own group; ask why (optional field? old app version?); impute (fill with a typical value) only under an agreed rule and with a flag column.", từ "impute" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Options for missing values, safest first: report the share missing; segment them as their own group; ask why (optional field? old app version?); impute (fill with a typical value) only under an agreed rule and with a flag column.", what does "impute" (verb) mean?
options: điền giá trị ước tính vào chỗ thiếu
optionsEn: to load data from a file
to fill a missing value with an estimate
items.explanation: impute /ɪmˈpjuːt/ (động từ): điền giá trị ước tính vào chỗ thiếu. Trong phân tích dữ liệu, "impute missing values" = điền giá trị thiếu. Nghĩa khác: quy (lỗi) cho ai.
items.explanationEn: impute /ɪmˈpjuːt/ (verb): to fill a missing value with an estimate. In data work, "impute missing values" means fill them in. Another sense: to attribute blame.

items.question: Trong câu "Options for missing values, safest first: report the share missing; segment them as their own group; ask why (optional field? old app version?); impute (fill with a typical value) only under an agreed rule and with a flag column.", từ "segment" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Options for missing values, safest first: report the share missing; segment them as their own group; ask why (optional field? old app version?); impute (fill with a typical value) only under an agreed rule and with a flag column.", what does "segment" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to cut a video into clips
items.explanation: segment /seɡˈment/ (động từ): tách thành nhóm riêng (phân khúc). "Segment customers by city" = phân khúc khách theo thành phố. Danh từ: "a segment" = một phân khúc.
items.explanationEn: segment /seɡˈment/ (verb): to split into separate groups. "Segment customers by city" means group them by city. Noun: "a segment".

items.question: Trong câu "Is the data fresh, has every process finished?", từ "fresh" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Is the data fresh, has every process finished?", what does "fresh" (adjective) mean?
options: mới, được cập nhật gần đây
items.explanation: fresh /freʃ/ (tính từ): mới, được cập nhật gần đây. "Data freshness" = độ mới của dữ liệu; nghĩa thường gặp khác là "tươi".
items.explanationEn: fresh /freʃ/ (adjective): recent, recently updated. "Data freshness" is how recent the data is; the everyday sense is about food.

items.question: Trong câu "Treating a missing history as a score of 0 drags the average down by about 28 points and invents 307 terrible borrowers.", từ "drag down" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Treating a missing history as a score of 0 drags the average down by about 28 points and invents 307 terrible borrowers.", what does "drag down" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: drag down /dræɡ daʊn/ (cụm từ): kéo xuống, làm giảm. "Drag the average down" = kéo trung bình xuống.
items.explanationEn: drag down /dræɡ daʊn/ (phrase): to pull a number lower. "Drag the average down" means make it lower.

items.question: Trong câu "Delete the 74-million earner and you erase a real customer.", từ "earner" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Delete the 74-million earner and you erase a real customer.", what does "earner" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: earner /ˈɜː.nə(r)/ (danh từ): người có thu nhập. "High earner" = người thu nhập cao.
items.explanationEn: earner /ˈɜː.nə(r)/ (noun): a person who earns money. A "high earner" is someone with a high income.

items.question: Trong câu "Delete the 74-million earner and you erase a real customer.", từ "erase" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Delete the 74-million earner and you erase a real customer.", what does "erase" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: erase /ɪˈreɪz/ (động từ): xóa bỏ hoàn toàn. "Erase data" = xóa dữ liệu, không lấy lại được.
items.explanationEn: erase /ɪˈreɪz/ (verb): to remove completely. "Erase data": remove it so it cannot be recovered.

items.question: Trong câu "Always look at the extremes first:", từ "extreme" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Always look at the extremes first:", what does "extreme" (noun) mean?
options: giá trị cực (lớn nhất, nhỏ nhất)
items.explanation: extreme /ɪkˈstriːm/ (danh từ): giá trị cực (lớn nhất, nhỏ nhất). "Look at the extremes" = xem các giá trị ở hai đầu: MIN, MAX.
items.explanationEn: extreme /ɪkˈstriːm/ (noun): the highest and lowest values. "Look at the extremes": check the MIN and MAX ends.

items.question: Trong câu "Nine 9s is a classic placeholder or typo.", từ "placeholder" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Nine 9s is a classic placeholder or typo.", what does "placeholder" (noun) mean?
options: giá trị giữ chỗ, điền tạm
optionsEn: someone holding a spot in a queue
a dummy value put in to fill a space
items.explanation: placeholder /ˈpleɪsˌhəʊl.də(r)/ (danh từ): giá trị giữ chỗ, điền tạm. Ví dụ placeholder: 999999999, 0, 'N/A', '1900-01-01'.
items.explanationEn: placeholder /ˈpleɪsˌhəʊl.də(r)/ (noun): a dummy value put in to fill a space. Common placeholders: 999999999, 0, 'N/A', '1900-01-01'.

items.question: Trong câu "The next value, 74.2 million, is believable.", từ "believable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The next value, 74.2 million, is believable.", what does "believable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: believable /bɪˈliː.və.bəl/ (tính từ): tin được, hợp lý. Believable ≠ verified: tin được nhưng chưa chắc đã kiểm chứng.
items.explanationEn: believable /bɪˈliː.və.bəl/ (adjective): easy to accept as true. Believable is not the same as verified.

items.question: Trong câu "Three rows out of 4,000 look harmless, but watch a segment:", từ "harmless" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Three rows out of 4,000 look harmless, but watch a segment:", what does "harmless" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: harmless /ˈhɑːm.ləs/ (tính từ): vô hại. "Look harmless" = trông vô hại (nhưng có thể không phải vậy).
items.explanationEn: harmless /ˈhɑːm.ləs/ (adjective): causing no harm. "Look harmless": seem safe, though they may not be.

items.question: Trong câu "Keep passing checks too: they are evidence, and they catch the day a release breaks something.", từ "evidence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Keep passing checks too: they are evidence, and they catch the day a release breaks something.", what does "evidence" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: facts that show something is true
items.explanation: evidence /ˈev.ɪ.dəns/ (danh từ): bằng chứng. "Evidence" là danh từ không đếm được: "a piece of evidence".
items.explanationEn: evidence /ˈev.ɪ.dəns/ (noun): facts that show something is true. "Evidence" is uncountable: "a piece of evidence".

items.question: Trong câu "Keep passing checks too: they are evidence, and they catch the day a release breaks something.", từ "release" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Keep passing checks too: they are evidence, and they catch the day a release breaks something.", what does "release" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a new version of software put live
items.explanation: release /rɪˈliːs/ (danh từ): bản phát hành phần mềm. "A new release" = một phiên bản mới được đưa lên production.
items.explanationEn: release /rɪˈliːs/ (noun): a new version of software put live. "A new release" is a version that goes live.

items.question: Trong câu "Stray spaces are invisible in most tools, which is why they survive.", từ "stray" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Stray spaces are invisible in most tools, which is why they survive.", what does "stray" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: lost and homeless, as of animals
items.explanation: stray /streɪ/ (tính từ): lạc chỗ, thừa ra. "Stray space / stray character" = dấu cách / ký tự thừa. Nghĩa khác: "stray dog" = chó hoang.
items.explanationEn: stray /streɪ/ (adjective): in the wrong place, unwanted. "Stray space": an unwanted space. Other sense: "stray dog".

items.question: Trong câu "Stray spaces are invisible in most tools, which is why they survive.", từ "invisible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Stray spaces are invisible in most tools, which is why they survive.", what does "invisible" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: invisible /ɪnˈvɪz.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): vô hình, không nhìn thấy. Dấu cách ở đầu/cuối chuỗi là ví dụ kinh điển của lỗi vô hình.
items.explanationEn: invisible /ɪnˈvɪz.ə.bəl/ (adjective): impossible to see. Leading/trailing spaces are the classic invisible error.

items.question: Trong câu "A mapping table beats a chain of Find & Replace: it is visible, reviewable and reusable next month.", từ "reusable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A mapping table beats a chain of Find & Replace: it is visible, reviewable and reusable next month.", what does "reusable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: reusable /ˌriːˈjuː.zə.bəl/ (tính từ): dùng lại được. Đối lập: "one-off" = chỉ dùng một lần.
items.explanationEn: reusable /ˌriːˈjuː.zə.bəl/ (adjective): able to be used again. Opposite: "one-off".

items.question: Trong câu "Profile any category column with `GROUP BY`:", từ "profile" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Profile any category column with `GROUP BY`:", what does "profile" (verb) mean?
options: khảo sát nhanh (đếm, đo) dữ liệu
optionsEn: to examine data with quick counts and stats
items.explanation: profile /ˈprəʊ.faɪl/ (động từ): khảo sát nhanh (đếm, đo) dữ liệu. "Data profiling" = khảo sát dữ liệu: số dòng, NULL, giá trị khác nhau, min, max.
items.explanationEn: profile /ˈprəʊ.faɪl/ (verb): to examine data with quick counts and stats. "Data profiling": row counts, NULLs, distinct values, min, max.

items.question: Trong câu "A customer pays by QR code, the network hiccups, the app retries, and the payment is recorded twice.", từ "retry" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A customer pays by QR code, the network hiccups, the app retries, and the payment is recorded twice.", what does "retry" (verb) mean?
options: thử lại, gửi lại yêu cầu
items.explanation: retry /ˌriːˈtraɪ/ (động từ): thử lại, gửi lại yêu cầu. "Automatic retry" = tự động gửi lại khi lỗi mạng; nguồn gốc của double charge.
items.explanationEn: retry /ˌriːˈtraɪ/ (verb): to try a request again. "Automatic retry": resend after a network error; a cause of double charges.

items.question: Trong câu "A customer pays by QR code, the network hiccups, the app retries, and the payment is recorded twice.", từ "hiccup" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A customer pays by QR code, the network hiccups, the app retries, and the payment is recorded twice.", what does "hiccup" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to make a sudden throat sound
to have a brief, small problem
items.explanation: hiccup /ˈhɪk.ʌp/ (động từ): trục trặc thoáng qua. Nghĩa đen: nấc cụt; nghĩa bóng: trục trặc nhỏ, ngắn.
items.explanationEn: hiccup /ˈhɪk.ʌp/ (verb): to have a brief, small problem. Literally a hiccup; figuratively a brief glitch.

items.question: Trong câu "Across all 37 pairs the gap is 1 to 8 seconds: the fingerprint of an automatic retry, not a customer buying twice.", từ "fingerprint" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Across all 37 pairs the gap is 1 to 8 seconds: the fingerprint of an automatic retry, not a customer buying twice.", what does "fingerprint" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a mark made by a finger
items.explanation: fingerprint /ˈfɪŋ.ɡə.prɪnt/ (danh từ): dấu hiệu đặc trưng. Nghĩa bóng: dấu vết đặc trưng giúp nhận ra nguyên nhân.
items.explanationEn: fingerprint /ˈfɪŋ.ɡə.prɪnt/ (noun): a characteristic sign. Figurative: a telltale sign that reveals the cause.

items.question: Trong câu "The extra three are different sessions days or months apart (payments 5889 and 6001: 83,000 VND each, about six days apart), a customer reordering the same lunch.", từ "reorder" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The extra three are different sessions days or months apart (payments 5889 and 6001: 83,000 VND each, about six days apart), a customer reordering the same lunch.", what does "reorder" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to change the order of items
to order the same thing again
items.explanation: reorder /ˌriːˈɔː.də(r)/ (động từ): đặt mua lại. Hai nghĩa: đặt mua lại, hoặc sắp xếp lại thứ tự.
items.explanationEn: reorder /ˌriːˈɔː.də(r)/ (verb): to order the same thing again. Two senses: buy again, or rearrange.

items.question: Trong câu "Removing those would delete real revenue.", từ "revenue" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Removing those would delete real revenue.", what does "revenue" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: income a business earns from sales
items.explanation: revenue /ˈrev.ən.juː/ (danh từ): doanh thu. Revenue (doanh thu) khác profit (lợi nhuận = doanh thu - chi phí).
items.explanationEn: revenue /ˈrev.ən.juː/ (noun): income a business earns from sales. Revenue is not profit (profit = revenue minus costs).

items.question: Trong câu "One (7568, from 2026-06-29) is under a day old, which is plausible; the other 17, worth 14,090,000 VND, are over a week old.", từ "plausible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One (7568, from 2026-06-29) is under a day old, which is plausible; the other 17, worth 14,090,000 VND, are over a week old.", what does "plausible" (adjective) mean?
options: hợp lý, có thể tin được
items.explanation: plausible /ˈplɔː.zə.bəl/ (tính từ): hợp lý, có thể tin được. "A plausible explanation" = một lời giải thích hợp lý.
items.explanationEn: plausible /ˈplɔː.zə.bəl/ (adjective): reasonable, likely to be true. "A plausible explanation" is a reasonable one.

items.question: Trong câu "The snapshot date is written literally: today's date would make the days-pending figure change on every rerun.", từ "snapshot" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The snapshot date is written literally: today's date would make the days-pending figure change on every rerun.", what does "snapshot" (noun) mean?
options: ảnh chụp dữ liệu tại một thời điểm
optionsEn: the state of data at one fixed moment
items.explanation: snapshot /ˈsnæp.ʃɒt/ (danh từ): ảnh chụp dữ liệu tại một thời điểm. "Snapshot date / as-of date" = ngày chốt số liệu.
items.explanationEn: snapshot /ˈsnæp.ʃɒt/ (noun): the state of data at one fixed moment. "Snapshot date" is the as-of date of the data.

items.question: Trong câu "The snapshot date is written literally: today's date would make the days-pending figure change on every rerun.", từ "literally" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The snapshot date is written literally: today's date would make the days-pending figure change on every rerun.", what does "literally" (adverb) mean?
options: viết cứng đúng giá trị (dạng literal)
optionsEn: as a fixed value typed in
items.explanation: literally /ˈlɪt.ər.əl.i/ (trạng từ): viết cứng đúng giá trị (dạng literal). Trong lập trình, "literal" = giá trị viết thẳng vào code, như '2026-06-30'.
items.explanationEn: literally /ˈlɪt.ər.əl.i/ (adverb): as a fixed value typed in. In code, a "literal" is a value typed directly, like '2026-06-30'.

items.question: Trong câu "The analyst does not decide whether a stuck payment succeeded; that needs the gateway's record.", từ "gateway" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The analyst does not decide whether a stuck payment succeeded; that needs the gateway's record.", what does "gateway" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: gateway /ˈɡeɪt.weɪ/ (danh từ): cổng thanh toán. "Payment gateway" = dịch vụ trung gian chuyển giao dịch giữa merchant và ngân hàng.
items.explanationEn: gateway /ˈɡeɪt.weɪ/ (noun): a payment gateway service. A "payment gateway" passes payments between merchant and bank.

items.question: Trong câu "If one stopped loading three days earlier, a last-7-days chart would show a fake drop.", từ "fake" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If one stopped loading three days earlier, a last-7-days chart would show a fake drop.", what does "fake" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: fake /feɪk/ (tính từ): giả, không có thật. "A fake drop" = cú sụt giả do dữ liệu, không phải do thực tế.
items.explanationEn: fake /feɪk/ (adjective): not real. "A fake drop" comes from the data, not from reality.

items.question: Trong câu "Likewise the 29 loan applications still `pending` were all submitted from 2026-06-27 on: recent and undecided, which is expected.", từ "undecided" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Likewise the 29 loan applications still `pending` were all submitted from 2026-06-27 on: recent and undecided, which is expected.", what does "undecided" (adjective) mean?

items.explanationEn: submit /səbˈmɪt/ (verb): to send in for a decision. "Submit an application" = send it in. Other sense: "submit to" = give in.

items.explanationEn: layer /ˈleɪ.ə(r)/ (noun): a level of processing on top of data. "Clean layer" or "staging layer".
